name: Asuka
source:
Characterized for being tall, slender and with tanned skin, Asuka is a professional beach volleyball player. She's working as a hostess for one reason mainly, that being a strain on her left foot; one she fears may end her career as a pro if not taken care of properly, so she works at the Dream Club while undergoing rehabilitation. She has a positive personality and is a hard worker, but doesn't do well with indecent jokes or comments, usually responding to them with a slap or two.

[spoiler]Her real name is Ootsuki Kaede (大槻 かえで).[/spoiler]
